description: The Piehouse Workers Co-op is a not-for-profit, worker-run, wheelchair accessible music venue. On 20th September we will throw a zine launch party. Come down to get a copy of our first Piehouse Zine with stalls by our resident artists, DJS & a BBQ.
facilities: Handrails on one side of stairs

factsheet.heading: Zine Fair
paragraphs: Piehouse Workers Co-op is hosting a zine fair celebrating independent publishing, community spaces and local people.
The event will launch our new Piehouse zine, telling the story of who we are, how the co-op and space work, and why community, collectively, workers-run spaces like ours are important.
Alongside the launch, we’ll be bringing together local organisations, independent publishers, zine makers and some of the residents and groups who regularly use Piehouse to share and sell their work.
It’s also a chance to come down and see Piehouse for yourself, meet some of the people who make up our community, explore our home in the railway arches, and have some pie and mash.

travel_info: Train: Deptford, Deptford Bridge, New Cross, New Cross Gate

name: Piehouse Workers Coop
